title: The Girl Named Asanagi Umi
overview: Maehara Maki bombs his intro at his new school, but it somehow comes back to help him.

title: Asanagi Umi and Amami Yuu
overview: When Maki and Umi go have fun outside, they run into some unexpected surprises.

title: The Second Prettiest Girl in Class
overview: As Maki and Yuu become friends, how will Umi react?

title: The Two and Their School Festival
overview: Yuu confronts the class about their treatment of Maki. How will this whole mess get resolved?

title: From Now On, and Then On
overview: Umi tells Maki how she and Yuu met, as well as the evolution of their friendship.

title: December with Friends
overview: While Maki's still reeling from Umi's declaration, he gets approached about something to do with Yuu.

title: First Date with a Friend
overview: After shopping, Maki and Umi go on their date, but the person Maki ran into lingers in his mind.

title: Family Sights
overview: After a study session with Umi, Yuu, and Seki, Maki confronts his father about a thorny issue.

title: Family Sights: Part Two
overview: Maki hasn't had the chance to sort out his feelings toward his family, and now he must go meet Umi's folks.

title: One Last Tantrum
overview: Maki has a plan to release his repressed feelings about his parents' divorce.

title: New Year's as Lovers
overview: Maki falls ill after everything that has happened, and Umi offers to take care of him.

title: To a New Season
overview: Valentine's Day is coming up, as is Umi's birthday. How do Maki and the gang feel as they head into spring?
